head: 2026년 추석, 언제부터 언제까지일까요
prompt: A wide low-angle photo taken at dusk in a traditional Korean hanok village, showing a large full moon rising directly above a curved black-tile roofline, warm orange sky gradient behind it, red persimmons hanging heavy on a bare tree branch in the foreground slightly out of focus, soft golden-hour light with long shadows, shot on a DSLR with shallow depth of field, no people, no text or signage visible anywhere in frame

head: 추석 장보기 전 꼭 확인할 것, 수산물 시장 상황
prompt: A candid documentary-style photo inside a bustling Korean traditional fish market early in the morning, a middle-aged Korean woman vendor wearing a rubber apron arranging fresh silver croaker and flatfish on crushed ice with her bare hands, steam rising faintly in the cold air, overhead fluorescent market lighting reflecting off wet stainless steel counters, shot from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle capturing rows of iced fish trays extending into the background, natural motion blur of other shoppers passing behind her, no signboards or price tags in focus
alt: 이른 아침 수산시장에서 상인이 얼음 위에 생선을 진열하는 모습, 뒤로 오가는 손님들이 흐릿하게 보인다

head: 차례상·명절 음식 장보기 알뜰 팁
prompt: A close-to-mid shot inside a Korean traditional market produce stall, a Korean woman in her 30s wearing a casual autumn cardigan carefully picking up a ripe pear with both hands to inspect it, crates of apples, Korean pears, and dried persimmons (gotgam) stacked around her, warm afternoon sunlight slanting in from the side creating soft highlights on the fruit skins, background softly blurred with more produce crates and a wicker basket already filled with items in her other hand, natural candid market atmosphere, no price signs or labels legible
alt: 전통시장에서 여성이 차례상용 배를 손으로 살펴보며 고르는 모습, 옆에는 사과와 곶감이 쌓여 있다
